entries.title: Jeremiah 2:1
segments: ¶Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:2
segments: "Go and cry in the hearing of Jerusalem, saying, 'Thus says the LORD: "I remember you, The kindness of your youth, The love of your betrothal, When you went after Me in the wilderness, In a land not sown.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:3
segments: Israel [was] holiness to the LORD, The firstfruits of His increase. All that devour him will offend; Disaster will come upon them," says the LORD.'"

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:4
segments: Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob and all the families of the house of Israel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:5
segments: Thus says the LORD: "What injustice have your fathers found in Me, That they have gone far from Me, Have followed idols, And have become idolaters?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:6
segments: Neither did they say, 'Where [is] the LORD, Who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, Who led us through the wilderness, Through a land of deserts and pits, Through a land of drought and the shadow of death, Through a land that no one crossed And where no one dwelt?'

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:7
segments: I brought you into a bountiful country, To eat its fruit and its goodness. But when you entered, you defiled My land And made My heritage an abomination.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:8
segments: The priests did not say, 'Where [is] the LORD?' And those who handle the law did not know Me; The rulers also transgressed against Me; The prophets prophesied by Baal, And walked after [things that] do not profit.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:9
segments: ¶"Therefore I will yet bring charges against you," says the LORD, "And against your children's children I will bring charges.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:10
segments: For pass beyond the coasts of Cyprus and see, Send to Kedar and consider diligently, And see if there has been such [a thing].

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:11
segments: Has a nation changed [its] gods, Which [are] not gods? But My people have changed their Glory For [what] does not profit.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:12
segments: Be astonished, O heavens, at this, And be horribly afraid; Be very desolate," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:13
segments: "For My people have committed two evils: They have forsaken Me, the fountain of living waters, [And] hewn themselves cisterns-broken cisterns that can hold no water.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:14
segments: ¶"[Is] Israel a servant? [Is] he a homeborn [slave]? Why is he plundered?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:15
segments: The young lions roared at him, [and] growled; They made his land waste; His cities are burned, without inhabitant.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:16
segments: Also the people of Noph and Tahpanhes Have broken the crown of your head.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:17
segments: Have you not brought this on yourself, In that you have forsaken the LORD your God When He led you in the way?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:18
segments: And now why take the road to Egypt, To drink the waters of Sihor? Or why take the road to Assyria, To drink the waters of the River?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:19
segments: Your own wickedness will correct you, And your backslidings will rebuke you. Know therefore and see that [it is] an evil and bitter [thing] That you have forsaken the LORD your God, And the fear of Me [is] not in you," Says the Lord GOD of hosts.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:20
segments: ¶"For of old I have broken your yoke [and] burst your bonds; And you said, 'I will not transgress,' When on every high hill and under every green tree You lay down, playing the harlot.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:21
segments: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, a seed of highest quality. How then have you turned before Me Into the degenerate plant of an alien vine?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:22
segments: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, [Yet] your iniquity is marked before Me," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:23
segments: "How can you say, 'I am not polluted, I have not gone after the Baals'? See your way in the valley; Know what you have done: [You are] a swift dromedary breaking loose in her ways,

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:24
segments: A wild donkey used to the wilderness, [That] sniffs at the wind in her desire; In her time of mating, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves; In her month they will find her.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:25
segments: Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, 'There is no hope. No! For I have loved aliens, and after them I will go.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:26
segments: "As the thief is ashamed when he is found out, So is the house of Israel ashamed; They and their kings and their princes, and their priests and their prophets,

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:27
segments: Saying to a tree, 'You [are] my father,' And to a stone, 'You gave birth to me.' For they have turned [their] back to Me, and not [their] face. But in the time of their trouble They will say, 'Arise and save us.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:28
segments: But where [are] your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, If they can save you in the time of your trouble; For [according to] the number of your cities Are your gods, O Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:29
segments: ¶"Why will you plead with Me? You all have transgressed against Me," says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:30
segments: "In vain I have chastened your children; They received no correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets Like a destroying lion.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:31
segments: "O generation, see the word of the LORD! Have I been a wilderness to Israel, Or a land of darkness? Why do My people say, 'We are lords; We will come no more to You'?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:32
segments: Can a virgin forget her ornaments, [Or] a bride her attire? Yet My people have forgotten Me days without number.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:33
segments: "Why do you beautify your way to seek love? Therefore you have also taught The wicked women your ways.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:34
segments: Also on your skirts is found The blood of the lives of the poor innocents. I have not found it by secret search, But plainly on all these things.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:35
segments: Yet you say, 'Because I am innocent, Surely His anger shall turn from me.' Behold, I will plead My case against you, Because you say, 'I have not sinned.'

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:36
segments: Why do you gad about so much to change your way? Also you shall be ashamed of Egypt as you were ashamed of Assyria.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:37
segments: Indeed you will go forth from him With your hands on your head; For the LORD has rejected your trusted allies, And you will not prosper by them.
